cardOverview.overviewText: A simple rewards card that earns points on everyday categories like shopping, groceries, and dining, with easy redemption options across partners.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to Axis Bank Customer Care at 1860 419 5555 or 1860 500 5555, or email email.services@axisbank.com.

benefitRows.name: Swiggy
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Swiggy app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy 30% off on Swiggy orders. Use the coupon code AXIS30 to avail the discount. Complete the payment using your Axis Rewards credit card to unlock the offer.
benefitRows.exclusion: This offer can be used twice a month.
